Kids & Family in Amsterdam this week

All this week's events

23 – 29 Nov · 20 events

Workshops, shows, markets and days out for children and the grown-ups who bring them. Events range from toddler-friendly afternoons to activities for older kids, and the organiser's page usually says which ages they suit. The list is refreshed every week, so it is easy to plan the weekend. Every listing is checked on the organiser's own page. Times and prices can change, so check the organiser's link before you go.

Showing today onwards

  5. Amsterdam Light Festival — Edition 15

    Art & Design · Kids & Family

    When
    Thu 26 Nov 2026 – Sun 17 Jan 2027, Lights 16:30–23:00 (31 Dec until 21:00)
    Where
    Walking route through the city centre (info point at Amstel 1 / Waterlooplein 6, Amsterdam) (Centrum)
    Price
    The 4.5 km route is in public space; paid app, guided walks and cruises sold separately
    Organiser
    Amsterdam Light Festival

    The fifteenth Amsterdam Light Festival places new light artworks above, beside and in the canals, from late November to mid-January. Walk the 4.5 km route yourself, or book a guided walk or cruise. On 26 November, 12 and 19 December the route also has Light Nights, with pop-up performances and storytellers.

    Details and tickets for Amsterdam Light Festival — Edition 15 (organiser's site)
